title: Two Sum (return indices)
source: LeetCode #1 Two Sum — the most-attempted coding problem; returns an index pair so it is deterministically checkable.
signature: function twoSum(nums, target)  // nums: number[], target: number -> [i, j] with i < j
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `twoSum(nums, target)` that returns the indices of the two numbers in `nums` that add up to `target`, as an array [i, j] with i < j. Assume exactly one solution exists and you may not use the same element twice.
